selection.convention: M10G: best validation checkpoint (primary), final checkpoint (secondary)

rate_point_rationale: Data-driven. A bit-depth probe found the M10H MC RD curve is vertical above 5-bit (8 -> 5 bit halves rate for 0.08 dB), so 8/6/5 could not support BD-rate. 5/4/3 spans 1.42 dB over a 2.1x rate range.

5bit_conditional.note: The conditional arm's residual grid is fitted to w = f_a(r, z_ref), the tensor it actually codes, on the TRAIN split only.
